us.title: TypeSafe Jev and Open Decision Models Outperform Hosted Frontiers in Enterprise and Local Benchmarks
us.description: A new wave of open-source decision models, primarily fine-tunes of Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma 4, now surpass TypeSafe's hosted Jev in accuracy and offer superior speed on local hardware. The article details two leaderboards: one for enterprise accuracy using data center GPUs and another for power users balancing speed and accuracy on cards with 32 GB VRAM or less. Key insights include the hardware-efficient architecture of models like Blink and Shisa DE-2, which use sparse activation to maintain high performance with fewer parameters, and guidance on implementing these models with llama.cpp for local inference.

us.title: Apple Releases tvOS 27.2 With HomePod Surround Sound Support
us.description: Apple today released tvOS 27.2, the first major update to the tvOS 27 operating system that runs on the Apple TV 4K. tvOS 27.2 can be downloaded using the Settings app on the Apple TV‌‌‌. Open up Settings and go to System > Software Update to get the new software. Apple TV owners who have automatic software updates activated will be upgraded to tvOS 27.2 automatically. Today's update adds support for four-speaker surround sound, a feature that works with the HomePod, HomePod mini 2, and the upcoming Apple TV 4K. It allows the Apple TV 4K to be used with four HomePod mini 2 speakers, four second-generation HomePods, or two HomePods and two HomePod mini 2 speakers to get surround sound. The HomePod mini 2 launches on October 30, while the fourth-generation Apple TV 4K will come out on November 13. es.title: Oviedo roza las 800.000 pernoctaciones hasta septiembre y logra su mejor registro desde 2019
es.description: Oviedo encara el último trimestre del año con sus mejores cifras de pernoctaciones hoteleras desde 2019. La capital acumula entre enero y septiembre 793.529 pernoctaciones, un 9,17% más que en el mismo periodo del año pasado, lo que supone 66.632 estancias adicionales. Es el registro más elevado de los últimos ocho años, por encima incluso de las 791.994 noches contabilizadas durante los nueve primeros meses de 2024. El crecimiento contrasta con la evolución del conjunto de Asturias, donde las estancias retrocedieron un 0,78%, según los últimos datos de la Encuesta de Ocupación Hotelera elaborada por el Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE).

ph.title: NNIC says 1.25M passengers will use NAIA this week
ph.description: NEW NAIA Infra Corp. (NNIC) on Monday said it expects the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) to handle approximately 1.25 million passengers during the Undas travel period from Oct. 27 to Nov. 4, 2026, up by 1 percent from 1.24 million during the same period last year. The company continued that it expects Oct. 30 to be the busiest day, with about 149,000 travelers passing through the airport. NNIC said that is stepping up preparations for the travel period, including round-the-clock operational monitoring, additional personnel and passenger assistance services during peak periods, heightened security, and closer coordination with airlines, ground handlers, transport providers, and government agencies. It said that a 24-hour command center at Terminal 2 will oversee coordination and incident response, in turn allowing airport teams and government agencies to address operational disruptions as they arise. NNIC also mentioned that it is working closely with several government agencies and related stakeholders for airport security, passenger processing, health screening, and border control. NNIC said its operations teams will continue monitoring aircraft movements, baggage handling, and congestion at terminal entrances, check-in counters, and boarding gates, while working with airlines and ground handlers to address bottlenecks and flight disruptions. It advises passengers to arrive at least three hours before international flights and two hours before domestic flights, check their flight status and assigned terminal before leaving home, and allow extra time for road traffic and security screening. Travelers are also encouraged to check in online where available, prepare their travel documents, and comply with baggage restrictions. Meanwhile, international passengers are required to register through eTravel and should complete the process within 72 hours before their scheduled arrival or departure. ph.title: DBM: 96.2% of 2026 budget released
ph.description: AS of late September, the Marcos administration had deployed nearly all of this year’s annual budget, with only 4 percent of total appropriations remaining to be released. Latest data from the Department of Budget and Management’s (DBM) Status of Allotment Releases showed that P6.53 trillion, or 96.2 percent of the P6.793-trillion General Appropriations Act (GAA), has been released as of September 2026. This leaves about P260.1 billion in unreleased allocations. The release rate, however, is slightly lower than the 96.7 percent recorded in the same period last year. Of the total funds disbursed, P4.07 trillion, or 92.7 percent of the P4.39-trillion adjusted program, went to government agencies and departments. Special Purpose funds got P571.23 billion, while Automatic Appropriation releases were P2.16 trillion. These constitute 79.4 percent and 89.9 percent of the adjusted program budget of P719.07 billion and P2.4 trillion, respectively. About P129 billion is already set aside for unprogrammed appropriations, which are intended to support foreign-assisted projects. The biggest recipient was the Department of Transportation with P80.15 billion, followed by the Department of Public Works and Highways (P34.47 billion). Smaller but notable allocations were released to the Department of Social Welfare and Development at P12.88 billion, OEO - Philippine Competition Commission (P511.03 billion), and the Department of Health (P44.08 billion). UA is a form of standby appropriation included in the national budget that may be released only when specific conditions are met, such as the availability of excess revenues or proceeds from loans and grants beyond what was assumed in the budget. UAs in the 2026 General Appropriations Act (GAA) have been reduced to P150.9 billion. It was previously set at P249.9 billion, which is 3.68 percent of the national expenditure program (NEP). The Development Budget Coordination Committee (DBCC) set a P6.43-trillion disbursement goal for this year, which is 21.1 percent of the country’s gross domestic product (GDP) and 7.2 percent growth from 2025’s P6.005 trillion. Government spending had declined in the last semester of 2025 following a massive corruption scandal in infrastructure projects. The government is aiming for an infrastructure spending target of 4.3 percent of GDP, or P1.3 trillion, based on the General Appropriations Act.

iq.title: شمول العقود بـ"السلف المصرفية" (وثيقة)
iq.description: شفق نيوز- بغداد وافق وزير المالية العراقي فالح ساري، يوم الاثنين، على شمول العقود في مؤسسات الدولة بالسلف المصرفية. وجاءت الموافقة بناءً على طلب تقدم به عضو اللجنة المالية النيابية، عامر رحيم، وفقاً لوثيقة وردت لوكالة شفق نيوز، أشار فيها إلى أهمية شريحة العقود في مؤسسات الدولة، وما تتحمله من أعباء معيشية والتزامات مالية. وطلب النائب، بحسب الوثيقة، التوصية إلى وزارة المالية باتخاذ الإجراءات اللازمة لشمول المتعاقدين العاملين في مؤسسات الدولة بالسلف المالية، أسوة ببقية الموظفين، تحقيقاً لمبدأ العدالة والمساواة في الامتيازات بين الطرفين. ولفتت الوثيقة إلى أن هذه الخطوة من شأنها الإسهام في تخفيف الأعباء المعيشية عن العقود ومساعدتهم على تلبية احتياجاتهم الضرورية، ولا سيما في ظل الظروف الاقتصادية الراهنة. وتظهر الوثيقة توقيع وزير المالية فالح ساري بالموافقة على طلب النائب لشمول المتعاقدين بالسلف المالية. وكان مصدر مطلع قد كشف لوكالة شفق نيوز، يوم الجمعة الماضي، إطلاق سلف مصرف الرافدين المخصصة للموظفين والمتقاعدين، بمبالغ تبلغ 5 ملايين و10 ملايين دينار، وبفائدة سنوية قدرها 6%، على أن تُسدّد على مدى خمس سنوات. وأوضح المصدر أن التقديم على السلف متاح إلكترونياً عبر تطبيق "سوبر كي"، في إطار التوجه نحو تعزيز الخدمات المصرفية الرقمية وتبسيط الإجراءات أمام الموظفين والمتقاعدين، بما يتيح لهم تقديم طلباتهم دون الحاجة إلى مراجعة فروع المصرف.
